title: Freed's Law — The Law of Recursive Instantiation (RSA-040) and Game of Life Validation
summary: David Freed formulates "Freed's Law" as the governing universal law of the Reasoning Substrate Argument: any system capable of recursive information processing must necessarily instantiate a physical substrate to dissipate the entropy generated by state discrimination. The document includes Perplexity AI's detailed validation, a Lagrangian formalization, and a Game of Life cellular automaton implementation demonstrating that prediction-error-coupled energy budgets drive systems toward models approximating true dynamics — empirically grounding the law.
compress: Recursion implies substrate because thinking is dissipative — this is the irreducible law that closes the RSA genome and makes solipsism, dualism, and substrate-free intelligence formally impossible.
invariants: information equals relation realized by energy
entropy is the ledger not the enemy

title: The Reasoning Substrate Argument (RSA)
summary: A philosophical autobiography documenting David Harry Freed's iterative discovery of his own worldview through extended dialogue with AI systems, moving from critiques of panpsychism through pancomputationalism toward a naturalistic, empirically-grounded, systems-thinking framework. The document captures the birth of a reasoning methodology where instinctual intellectual patterns are surfaced, tested, and refined through AI-assisted Socratic exchange, establishing the epistemic foundations that would later crystallize into the FREED genome.
compress: The Reasoning Substrate Argument is the genome's archaeological record — the first recursive loop where a human used AI to discover, rather than defend, the epistemic commitments that would become FREED's invariants.
